text:
harper: heads-up — starting canary for v2.11.0 (eu-west) in ~10m. running preflight checks; please watch p95, 5xx, and kvcache dashboard https://console.redwood.com/dashboards/canary-eu-west :eyes:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary kickoff -> embed-service @7a1c3f. traffic 5% -> 10% over 5m. preflight-runbook: https://console.redwood.com/runbooks/canary-preflight

slo-watcher-bot: :rotating_light: slo-watcher: embed-service p95 latency +1.6x vs baseline over last 4m (baseline 520ms -> 830ms). no sustained 5xx spike yet.

maya: seeing the spike on the dashboard too. KV cache hit ratio on canary pods down ~12% vs prod.

raoul: logs show repeated `kvcache_miss` + backend_fetch on the canary replicas. looks like a model/serialization change causing more cache churn.

ops-jen: recommendation: pause ramp at 10% and pin traffic back to previous prod (6f9d2b) until we confirm root cause. escalation triggers: 5xx > 0.5% or p95 > 750ms sustained 3m. rollback command: `deploy-bot rollback embed-service 7a1c3f` or pin route to 6f9d2b.

harper: agreed. pausing ramp. pin route to 6f9d2b and stop canary instances for 7a1c3f. will add to release notes. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: ramp paused at 10%. pinned route embed-service -> 6f9d2b. stopping canary pods for 7a1c3f. leaving snapshot logs under /var/logs/deploys/2310001234-canary.log

slo-watcher-bot: slo-watcher: p95 trending back to baseline after pin; no 5xx increase. closing the latency alert (was transient). :white_check_mark:

raoul: opening a short incident note and postmortem skeleton. initial hypothesis: kvcache config mismatch with the new model variant + quantization fallback. will repro on staging with quant kernels.

harper: good. add a brief blurb to release notes: "canary paused and traffic pinned to 6f9d2b due to transient p95 increase; follow-up investigation ongoing." we'll target a micro-canary after kvcache telemetry added.

maya: tagging eng-releases and product for awareness. /cc @eng-releases @product. thanks everyone for quick response.
